doc.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: How the Shaw organization was run and its size
summary: Describes the manager, lawyer, PR man, and a 14-piece band with singer; new arrangements were added frequently.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Just going back to a little bit before that, when . . . around about the time of Begin the Beguine and so on. Just for the record, how did the band function? Who looked after what? Who took care of various aspects? Did you have . . .
I heard that. Who took care of what?
Who took care of the various aspects of running a band, like the management?
We had a road manager. Had a lawyer. Had a PR man [public relations]. Had all that stuff.
What size organization did you have?

The band? It was about . . . let’s see . . . 3 brass, I mean 6 brass, 4 reeds. 10 and rhythm. 14 men and two . . . and a singer. 15 and myself. Besides that, there was a lawyer who handled the finances and the contracts. There was a band manager who came on the road and handled the reservations and the transportation. And a bus driver when we were doing that. That was it. Occasional go-fers. Somebody would set up the bandstand.
How often did you add new arrangements?
